name: When should I call a professional for a slow drain instead of trying DIY methods?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a slow drain instead of trying DIY methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for a slow drain if basic DIY methods like plunging don't work, if you have multiple slow drains in your home, or if you suspect a more serious issue like a main sewer line blockage. Attempting aggressive DIY solutions can sometimes damage your pipes, especially older ones, leading to more costly repairs. CG Plumbing Solutions can perform a video inspection to accurately diagnose the problem without guesswork. This precise diagnostic helps avoid unnecessary damage and ensures a long-lasting fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if DIY methods fail, you have multiple slow drains, or suspect a main line issue. Professionals can diagnose accurately to prevent pipe damage.
